units.name: CO2 feed compressor
units.purpose: pressurise fresh CO2 from boundary pressure to reactor loop pressure

units.name: H2 feed compressor
units.purpose: pressurise fresh hydrogen from boundary pressure to reactor loop pressure

units.name: feed mixer
units.purpose: combine compressed fresh feeds with recycle gas

units.name: feed effluent heat exchanger
units.purpose: recover hot reactor effluent heat to preheat mixed feed

units.name: trim heater
units.purpose: raise preheated feed to selected reactor inlet temperature when heat recovery is insufficient

units.name: cooled methanation reactor
units.purpose: convert CO2 and H2 to methane and water over the selected catalyst while removing exothermic heat

units.name: effluent cooler and water knockout
units.purpose: cool effluent, condense and remove produced water before gas purification/recycle

units.name: methane purification membrane
units.purpose: separate methane product from unreacted CO2/H2 and light byproducts for recycle and purge

units.name: product compressor
units.purpose: compress purified methane product to pipeline delivery pressure

units.name: recycle compressor
units.purpose: restore recycle-rich gas pressure after separation pressure drop and return it to the reactor loop

units.name: offsites and utilities
units.purpose: cooling water, boiler feedwater, flare/thermal oxidizer for purge, controls, wastewater handling and balance-of-plant services

catalyst_regeneration.excluded: No periodic in-situ regeneration unit is included because literature records generally report steady operation or replacement rather than oxidative regeneration, and methanation catalysts risk sintering under regeneration.

diagram:
flowchart LR
  CO2[Fresh CO2] --> C1[CO2 feed compressor]
  H2[Fresh H2] --> C2[H2 feed compressor]
  C1 --> M[feed mixer]
  C2 --> M
  RC[recycle compressor] --> M
  M --> HX[feed effluent heat exchanger]
  HX --> TH[trim heater]
  TH --> R[cooled methanation reactor]
  R --> HX
  HX --> KO[effluent cooler and water knockout]
  KO --> SEP[methane purification membrane]
  SEP --> PC[product compressor]
  PC --> OS[offsites and utilities]
  SEP --> RC
  SEP --> OS
  KO --> OS
  OS --> CH4[export methane]
